notes.title: v1.52 + v1.53 Update - Dynamic horde spawning system, kill streak, and more!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=JDt90rVOIPI;full][/previewyoutube]
Added dynamic horde spawning system based on kills.

Added the first draft of Kill Streak for the score bonus.

Yo-Yo Pause
-Allowed canceling when missed but without duplicating yo-yos to increase agency and further nerf the instant pausing play style.

Combo calculation changed from exponential to linear growth to suppress the ever-increasing yo-yos in the end game.

The existing yo-yos now get destroyed upon hit to improve battlefield readability.

Ultimate
-Repositioned as the main way to wipe out enemies in the end game, where supporting efficient recalls becomes its secondary benefit.
-The Yo-Yo main weapon can shoot a lot further under bullet time.
-It now deals 99 damage along with a pushing effect.
-Bullet time now lasts up to 10 seconds.

Recall
-Changed from recalling every existing yo-yo back to only the ones marked in front of the player.

Updated skill icon UI

Black Bomb
-Can now be triggered to detonate both by a regular yo-yo shot and the player.
-Can no longer be pushed after being triggered.
-Detonation can chain react to trigger more bombs within range.

Added 2 Steam achievements:
-A Handful!
-True Air Born!

Added mouse sensitivity configuration option.

notes.title: v1.51 Update - Graphic Settings Available!
notes.notes:
-Added the new Options menu that allows for various graphic settings.
-Ability tuning that includes Icon updates to reflect the latest gameplay iteration based on the playtest feedback.
